note: One entry per scheduled task. The page builds a View-menu tab for each. Times are IST. days: 'weekdays' = Mon-Fri (NSE holidays are skipped by the run itself), 'daily' = every day.

schedules.name: Pre-Market News
schedules.summary: Stock-level news before the 9:15 open: company news, FII/FPI desk calls, technical trade levels, promoter & insider activity, FII stock-wise flows.

schedules.name: JCGG Morning Updates (Brief)
schedules.summary: Gold-letterhead brief: today's bias (framed), global & Asian markets, GIFT Nifty & commodities, VIX & USD/INR, key levels, alerts.

schedules.name: JCGG Morning Updates (Detailed)
schedules.summary: Full-depth pre-market report: global close, Asia, GIFT Nifty, commodities, VIX/INR, outlook, levels, sectors, trading ideas, corporate-action & F&O ban calendar.

schedules.name: JCGG Morning Pulse Infographic
schedules.summary: Vibrant dark-gradient infographic of the morning data: mood, GIFT Nifty hero, market tiles, range bars for key levels, alerts.

schedules.name: Evening Market Wrap
schedules.summary: Closing snapshot: Indian indices, global wrap, currencies/commodities/bonds, Nifty 500 top gainer & loser, volume shockers, near-term outlook.

schedules.name: Evening News Wrap
schedules.summary: Day's market-moving news plus next trading day's results, IPO and corporate-action calendar.

schedules.summary: F&O stocks whose 3:40 PM auction close moved ±1% or more from the 3:15 PM reference price, with catalysts.

schedules.summary: Price-band & momentum scanner: circuit hits, fresh 52-week highs/lows on heavy volume, hedged recommendations and verification notes.
